name: Bend Health
one_liner: Online mental health care for kids, teens and young adults (ages 1–25): coaching, therapy and psychiatry, with parents involved.
best_for: Parents of children or teens with anxiety, depression, ADHD or behavior problems
Families who want parents involved in care
Young adults up to about age 25
Families with insurance that covers Bend, or who can pay monthly
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988, or call 911
Children who need inpatient or residential care
short_description: Video coaching, therapy and psychiatry for ages 1–25 with parents involved; insurance or $199.99–$549.99/month self-pay.
long_description: Bend Health is a US virtual behavioral health practice for children, teens and young adults (ages 1–25 in a 2026 review). A care team of behavioral coaches, licensed therapists and psychiatric clinicians works with the young person and their caregivers by video, and caregivers report symptoms every month so the team can adjust care (measurement-based care). It treats anxiety, depression, ADHD, behavior problems and related concerns, and a 2026 review also lists a virtual intensive outpatient program. Bend says self-pay, insurers and employer partners extend access to all 50 states and DC, though therapy availability varies by location. Self-pay is $199.99 a month for coaching (not covered by insurance), $399.99 with therapy, and $549.99 with medication management. Bend's own researchers have published uncontrolled studies of its members, including one of 114 children and teens in which about 73% had improved anxiety or depression scores.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; $199.99/month self-pay (coaching), $399.99 with therapy, $549.99 with medication
pricing.notes: Coaching alone is not insurance-eligible. Many insurance plans and employer benefits accepted; check coverage with Bend. Prices from a 2026 review; confirm on Bend's financial policy page.

privacy.notes: Website policy (read 2026-10-27) lets third-party ad networks use cookies to track browsing and deliver targeted ads, with a Do Not Sell or Share opt-out; deletion is listed only as a European right (account pages 'may' allow it); PHI is handled under HIPAA.

faqs.q: What ages does Bend Health serve?
faqs.a: Bend Health primarily serves children and adolescents from early childhood through high school age, plus their parents/caregivers. The whole-family model means parents are actively involved in treatment. Adult-only services are not the focus.

faqs.q: What conditions does Bend Health treat?
faqs.a: Bend Health treats childhood anxiety, depression, ADHD, behavioral challenges, school stress, family conflict, and adjustment issues. They use evidence-based approaches appropriate for children and teens. For severe conditions or active safety concerns, a higher level of care may be needed.

Yes, Bend Health accepts many major insurance plans. They also partner with employers to provide covered services. Check their website or contact them to verify your specific plan's coverage in your state.

faqs.q: How is Bend Health different from regular therapy?
faqs.a: Bend Health uses a collaborative care team model rather than just one therapist. Your child might work with a therapist, coach, and psychiatrist who coordinate together. Parents receive support and coaching too. This integrated approach often produces better outcomes than fragmented care.

clinical_trials.study: Retrospective analysis of anxiety and depression outcomes among Bend Health members aged 6–17

citation.title: Using Digital Measurement–Based Care for the Treatment of Anxiety and Depression in Children and Adolescents: Observational Retrospective Analysis of Bend Health Data

clinical_trials.outcome: 73% of the anxiety group (72/98) and 73% of the depression group (44/61) improved; depression scores were largely stable among those who didn't screen out. No control group; all authors employed by Bend.

primary_uses: Anxiety and depression care for children and teens
Behavioral coaching for kids and parents

availability.note: Ages 1–25 only. Bend says it reaches all 50 states and DC through self-pay, insurers and employers; therapy availability varies by location.

patient_summary: You sign your child up online, and a care team of coaches, therapists and psychiatric clinicians works with your child and you by video, tracking symptoms with regular check-ins. Bend takes many insurance plans; self-pay runs $199.99 a month for coaching only, up to $549.99 a month with therapy and medication.
